evaluation_day.description: The assessed day = last full day (AD-8); the window never includes it.

window_days.description: Median of the 14 calendar days before evaluation_day (D21, AD-8). A different window is a new schema version.

sample_days.description: Days of the window that have a version in fact_cabinet_daily_current; a gap must stay visible.

value.description: Money/amount as a string with exactly two decimal places (AD-10); mirrors the DB numeric(14,2) column. Median of the sampled days; for orders it may carry a fractional part (median of an even sample).

source_refs.description: Evidence pointers (AD-1): content_sha256 of the fact versions the median was taken over; never empty.
